title: Global 100m Projections of Biodiversity Intactness for the years 2017-2025 (v1.1)
description:
Annual global 100 m gridded maps of terrestrial Biodiversity Intactness, extended to 2017–2025.

This is an update of the Biodiversity Intactness product by Impact Observatory and Vizzuality, originally covering 2017-2020 (Gassert, Mazzarello & Hyde 2022). This release re-runs it on updated input datasets refreshing and extending the timeseries to 2017-2025.
